# SoDak Services

> Locally owned lawn care and landscaping company in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, run by Anthony Erickson and Preston Ver Steeg (SoDak Services Group LLC), mowing since 2021.

- Services: weekly lawn mowing (trimming, edging, blow-off included), landscaping, spring and fall yard cleanups, commercial and HOA lawn care
- Service area: Sioux Falls, Harrisburg, Tea and Brandon, SD
- Pricing: every yard gets a free, exact quote based on its size, within one business day; billed per visit
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7 AM to 7 PM
- How it works: each customer gets a set mow day; if rain pushes it, the crew texts you and comes back within 24 to 48 hours
- Free quotes: call or text (605) 254-0988, email servicessodak@gmail.com, or use the form at https://www.sodakservices.com/contact/
